question: As per the Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act-2003, which of the following is NOT laid before both the house of parliament along with Annual Financial statement?

options.text: The medium term fiscal policy statement

solution:
The correct answer is __**The monetary policy statement**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management (FRBM) Act, 2003,** mandates that the central government lay down certain financial documents before both Houses of Parliament, along with the Annual Financial Statement (Union Budget).
 
• These documents include:
 
 
• The **Medium-Term Fiscal Policy Statement**, which outlines the government's fiscal goals and how these goals will be achieved over a period of three years.
 
• The **Fiscal Policy Strategy Statement**, which explains the key policies and priorities of the government for achieving fiscal targets.
 
• The **Macroeconomic Framework Statement**, which provides an overview of the economic outlook, including GDP growth, fiscal balance, and external sector performance.
